data.name: Awaida
data.gender_notes: Awaida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who brings happiness and joy. The name Awaida carries the meaning “Happy, Joyful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Awaida usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, joyful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of joy and happiness, often associated with the beauty of nature
data.etymology: Awaida belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happy, Joyful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awaida total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عويدة
in_arabic.meaning: عويدة تعني العودة الى الله تعالى والتوجه نحوه
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عويدة مشتق من العودة، وهو مصدر للفعل عاد، ويعني الرجوع الى الله تعالى والتوجه نحوه، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفاتحة 'إياك نعبد وإياك نستعين' حيث يعود المسلمون الى الله في عبادتهم و استعينتهم، واسم عويدة يوحي بالتوجه الى الله والاعتماد عليه

in_urdu.name: عويدة
in_urdu.meaning: عويدة مطلب ہے اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف لوٹنا اور اس کی طرف رجوع کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عويدة نام کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف لوٹنا، یہ نام عاد فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں واپسی یا رجوع، اسلامی روایت میں یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کی طرف رجوع اور اس پر بھروسہ کرنے کی تاکید کرتا ہے، جیسا کہ قرآن مجید میں 'إياك نعبد وإياك نستعين' میں آیا ہے، جو عبادت اور مدد کے لئے اللہ کی طرف رجوع کی تاکید کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अवैदा
in_hindi.meaning: अवैदा का अर्थ है अल्लाह की ओर लौटना और उसकी ओर मुड़ना
in_hindi.long_meaning: अवैदा नाम अल्लाह की ओर लौटने के अर्थ में है, जो 'عاد' क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है वापसी या पुनरागमन, इस्लामी परंपरा में यह नाम अल्लाह की ओर मुड़ने और उस पर भरोसा करने पर जोर देता है, जैसा कि कुरआन में 'إياك نعبد وإياك نستعين' में उल्लेख है, जो अल्लाह की ओर लौटने और उसकी मदद मांगने की आवश्यकता पर प्रकाश डालता है

in_pashto.name: عویده
in_pashto.meaning: عویده د الله تعالی طرف ته د راستنېدو معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عویده نوم د الله تعالی طرف ته د راستنېدو د معنا څخه مشتق شوی دی، دا نوم د عاد فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د ر帰 یا پرانستنې معنی لري، په اسلامي دود کې دا نوم د الله تعالی طرف ته د ميل او د هغه پر ايمان ټينګار کوي، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کريم کې 'إياك نعبد وإياک نستعين' راغلی دی، کوم چې د عبادت او مدد لپاره د الله تعالی طرف ته د راستنېدو ټينګار کوي

in_english.name: Awaida
in_english.meaning: Awaida means returning to Allah and turning to Him
in_english.long_meaning: The name Awaida is derived from the Arabic root 'عاد' (ʿ-w-d), which means to return or go back, in the context of Islamic tradition, Awaida signifies turning to Allah and relying on Him, as emphasized in the Quran, 'إياك نعبد وإياك نستعين' (We worship You and seek Your help), reflecting a spiritual inclination towards Allah and dependence on Him

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عویده

data.cultural_impact: The name "Awaida" is a beautiful and meaningful name rooted in Arab culture. It signifies a woman who brings happiness, joy, and positivity into the lives of those around her. This is a loving and admirable quality, and is highly valued in many Arab societies where hospitality and the nurturing of social bonds are essential for community building and personal fulfillment. The name can be deeply meaningful in relationships, as a reminder of the importance of contributing positively to the happiness of loved ones. In daily life, the name may serve as a source of inspiration for women to behave in a joyful and pleasant manner towards others. It can also influence how people perceive and interact with those bearing the name, treating them with kindness and respect.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Awaida" has spiritual significance as it embodies the concept of bringing joy and happiness to others as a reflection of God's love and blessings. In Islamic thought, blessings and happiness are seen as gifts from God, and it is a duty for individuals to share these gifts with others, particularly through acts of kindness, compassion, and generosity. By carrying the name "Awaida," a person is reminded of their role as a conduit of God's love and blessings to those around them. This can inspire them to strive towards living a virtuous life, and to be a source of positivity and grace in their interactions with others. The name also serves as a reminder of the importance of cultivating a joyful and grateful disposition towards life, as gratitude and happiness are essential for spiritual growth and connection to the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Happy, Joyful" symbolizes A woman who brings happiness and joy. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Awaida serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of happy, joyful.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hajar al-Haytami mentioned Awaida as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Awaida carried significant weight in that era.
